app.name: Lectern
app.tagline: A local workbench for chat and OCR.

common.loadFailed: Lectern didn't answer. Check that `lectern serve` is still running, then reload.

errors.noToken: Open Lectern from the link that `lectern serve` printed. That link contains the access key this page needs.

below_minimum.name: Below minimum
below_minimum.summary: No usable GPU. Models run on the processor: it works, but slowly.

minimum.name: Minimum
minimum.summary: A 4B chat model. One model sits on the GPU at a time, so OCR and chat take turns.

recommended.name: Recommended
recommended.summary: A 9B chat model. OCR and chat swap on the GPU while a document is processed.

comfortable.name: Comfortable
comfortable.summary: Larger models, and chat and OCR can stay loaded together.

firstRun.title: Set up Lectern
firstRun.intro: Lectern runs every model on this computer. First, here's what it found, and the chat model that suits it.
firstRun.notEnoughDisk: There isn't enough free disk space for this model, plus 1 GB to spare. Free some space, then reload.
firstRun.sandboxFound: {{runtime}} {{version}} is running. Lectern will use it to run the scripts its models write, each in an isolated container.
firstRun.sandboxStopped: {{runtime}} is installed but not running. Start it so Lectern can run the scripts its models write.
firstRun.sandboxMissing: Neither Podman nor Docker is installed.
firstRun.sandboxWhy: Without one, Lectern can't run scripts, so answers that need exact numbers are marked not computed. Everything else works.

modelsPage.title: Models & memory
modelsPage.onFirstUse: Only the chat model is downloaded during setup. The others download the first time they're needed.

memory.title: Memory
memory.gaugeLabel: {{pct}}% of the memory for models in use
memory.nothingLoaded: No model is loaded. The first chat or job loads one.

roleState.crashed: Stopped unexpectedly; restarts on next use

policy.title: Sharing the GPU

when_models_dont_fit.title: When two models don't fit together
when_models_dont_fit.swap_between_phases: Swap between phases: finish the current phase for every page, then swap
when_models_dont_fit.keep_one_loaded: Keep one model loaded: jobs that need another model wait

chat_during_job.title: If you chat during a job
chat_during_job.pause_job_after_current_item: Pause the job after the current page
chat_during_job.chat_waits: Chat waits until the job has finished

policy.mlx: Use MLX for MLX models (Apple Silicon)
policy.mlxWhy: MLX can be faster on a Mac, but its servers can't be protected with a key yet, so websites you visit could reach them. Leave off unless you're testing.

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No projects yet. A project is a folder for your chats and files.
